tools.name: list_active_signals
tools.description: List ranked active signals from VolatiAI (severity x confidence x magnitude x novelty). Filter by severity or category.

tools.name: get_sector
tools.description: Get current data for one sector. Sector slugs from list_active_signals output.

tools.name: verify_snapshot
tools.description: Verify a VolatiAI snapshot's chain integrity and return its signature fields for independent verification. Use this to prove the data hasn't been tampered with.

tools.name: find_corroborations
tools.description: Find groups of active signals measuring the same metric (e.g. BTC price from multiple exchanges). High disagreement_pct (>1%) suggests arbitrage or a data-source discrepancy.

tools.name: get_diff
tools.description: Compare two snapshots. Returns regressions (worked yesterday, broken today), recoveries (broken yesterday, working today), new sectors, and disappeared sectors. Default: compares current day to previous day.

tools.name: get_current_revision
tools.description: Return the single canonical 'what is current' pointer: snapshot date, hash, signed_at, pubkey_id, and previous revision. Use this before querying a specific snapshot date to know what's freshest.

tools.name: get_anchor
tools.description: Return anchor-log status for a snapshot date: was an anchor entry recorded, what was the file SHA-256 at anchor time vs now, is a FreeTSA .tsr present. Detects post-hoc rewrites that signature verification alone cannot.

tools.name: get_trust_manifest
tools.description: One-call discovery: returns all URLs, algorithms, tools, and the 4-step verification chain a consumer needs to independently verify VolatiAI data. No snapshot fetch. Use first to learn where everything lives.

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description: Resolve a slug, alias, or entity ID to a canonical VolatiAI entity. Returns the entity metadata, all sectors it appears in, external ID mappings (CoinGecko, Wikidata), and evidence links from the entity registry. Warnings flag metric incomparability (e.g. btc-exchange-spread and eth-exchange-spread

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List all canonical entities in the VolatiAI entity registry. Use to discover what entities are known and which sectors map to them. Optional type filter (e.g. "asset", "organization", "product", "game").

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_anchor, get_trust_manifest · Private data: get_anchor · Public sink: get_anchor, resolve_entity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_anchor, get_trust_manifest · Private data: get_anchor · Public sink: get_anchor, resolve_entity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
